svg.title: TabPFN v3.5 - classifier
svg.desc: Prior-Labs - one multitask checkpoint; three stages: per column, per row, in context · 219.0 M parameters. Symbols in shapes: B: ensemble members (batch); n: rows in the context (train + test); p: raw features; F: feature groups; n_test: test rows (the rows being predicted). Abbreviations: ICL: in-context learning: test rows attend to the labelled training rows; CLS: learned summary token that reads out a row or column; RoPE: rotary position embedding; MLP: multilayer perceptron (the feed-forward sublayer); GELU: Gaussian error linear unit (activation); LayerNorm: layer normalisation; RMSNorm: root-mean-square normalisation; QK: query and key (as in QK-norm); KV: keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads); NaN: not-a-number: undefined values in the input; ECDF: empirical cumulative distribution function; MQA: multi-query attention: every query head shares one set of keys and values. How to read: the data flows upwards, from the input table to the prediction; a line up the right-hand side ending in a circled plus: a residual connection, adding the input of the steps it passes back to their output; a box at the left meeting the flow at a circled plus: that stage's output is added to the flow; N ×: the steps in the tinted container are stacked N times; small boxes at the left feed the step their arrow points to; dark boxes are attention; the line under the name says where its keys come from, which tokens query in the last block, how it is scaled, and how many key/value heads the test rows read; beside the arrows: the tensor shape each stage emits, in the symbols above; dotted lines: facts about the part they point to, with the numbers in the model's colour.
